value.rationale: The exact joint phase-dependent LZ/novLZ phrase spectrum, with gap up to six and forced gain at some root of every cycle, is a natural complete compression benchmark over a family with uniform length-five factor coverage. It does not follow from either general parse-ratio inequalities or an LZ78 census, and can guide exact comparisons between self-overlap and source-disjoint parsing choices.
